intent: Render the filtered items of a Combobox, or of the enclosing ComboboxGroup, by calling a function once per item.
typical_uses: The items of one group in a grouped list, mapped from that group's own `items`

dont_use_when.situation: A flat list with no groups

instead.note: Pass the function as ComboboxList's own children; the list wraps it in a collection itself.

invariants.text: Inside a ComboboxGroup given `items`, the collection maps that group's items; anywhere else it maps the root's filtered items. It renders nothing of its own, only what the function returns.

children.states: children is a function of an item and its index returning the React nodes to render for it
children.because: `(item: any, index: number) => ReactNode` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.

bad.title: Node children instead of a function
bad.why: The collection calls its children once per item, so they must be a function of the item; a node child is not callable, and the render throws as soon as there is an item to map.

children.description: TS: (item: any, index: number) => ReactNode. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. children is a function of an item and its index returning the React nodes to render for it. `(item: any, index: number) => ReactNode` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.
